stem:
In the diagram shown each circle represents a group of polygons. If a polygon belongs in a circle, it also belongs in any larger circle.

[Diagram: Three concentric circles, labeled from largest to smallest as Quadrilaterals, Parallelograms, Rectangles. The smallest circle (Rectangles) is shaded.]

Which kind of polygon belongs in the shaded circle?
visual_elements: Diagram with three concentric circles labeled Quadrilaterals, Parallelograms, Rectangles; the smallest circle (Rectangles) is shaded
